description: This PHP source file defines a class `JsonRPCServer` that implements a server handling JSON-RPC requests in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods to initialize, run the server, process incoming requests, perform user authentication, and handle JSON encoding/decoding, along with external dependencies and server setup logic.

classes.description: A server class that handles JSON-RPC requests, authenticates users, and responds with JSON data. It manages server startup, request processing, and error handling in the SuiteCRM environment.
